summary: Through the review date of August 6, 2024, the borrower has received the Amazon break fee, reduced inventory, and met all reporting obligations. No new developments indicate that the existing covenant package fails to address emerging risks, so no material drift is detected.

clauses.rationale: No new evidence of insufficient Amazon break fee receipts or other prepayments that would trigger step‑up; the test’s thresholds remain supported.
Financial statements continue to be delivered on schedule with no going‑concern exceptions observed; reporting requirements remain adequate.
Monthly compliance certificates are being delivered as required; no evidence of delays or calculation issues.
Amazon break fee has been received and applied per the sweep; no evidence of non‑compliance or need to adjust the sweep mechanics.
No notices of default or event of default have been issued; the notice provision remains fit for purpose.

drift_reasons: Evidence shows the Amazon break fee was received and used, inventory has fallen significantly, financial statements are timely, and no defaults have occurred; thus the existing covenant package continues to address risks without needing tightening or new protections.
